title: Hi Guys or Hi Folks? Benchmarking Gender-Neutral Machine Translation with the GeNTE Corpus

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation (MT) models using a contrastive benchmark (GeNTE) that tests the translation of gender-ambiguous English sentences into Italian. The evaluation employs both reference-based metrics (e.g., BLEU, TER, METEOR, neural metrics) to compare MT outputs against manually created gendered and gender-neutral references, and a reference-free evaluation using a trained classifier (UmBERTo) to detect whether outputs are gendered or neutral.
